description: List the DocStar organizations (workspaces) the signed-in user belongs to, with each one's id and name (the list is at data.data). Start every DocStar task here: show the user the organizations and ask which one to use, unless there is only one. The chosen id is the orgId every other DocStar tool needs.

itemsPerPage.description: Page size; the DocStar UI uses 50. e.g. 50

pageNo.description: Page number (standard MSG91 pagination; not used by the DocStar UI, inferred). e.g. 1

name: list_organizations
